answer: In a decentralized economy of AI agents, the Anchor-based mechanism provides robust resistance against fake-identity attacks. This mechanism involves each agent maintaining a unique anchor marble, a digital token that serves as its identity. Any agent attempting to create multiple fake identities must first accumulate a substantial amount of anchor marbles, rendering it a costly endeavor. As a result, a haven of trust is established among genuine agents, while fake identities are left to languish, isolated from the economic network.
